roles.title: Process and plant operations
roles.summary: Keep processing equipment running safely and learn from its measurements.
roles.explanation: Operators put a process into practice. They inspect equipment, record operating conditions and work with engineers and maintenance teams when results differ from what was expected.

tasks.title: Monitor the process
tasks.detail: Take readings and inspect equipment for signs of unusual behaviour.

tasks.detail: Report problems, support maintenance and help with commissioning or start-up work.
